content.introduction: The Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity (LISEP) was created in 2019 by Gene Ludwig and his wife, Dr. Carol Ludwig, with a mission to improve the economic well-being of middle- and lower-income Americans through research and education. LISEP's original economic research includes new indicators for unemployment, earnings, and cost of living. According to a report from LISEP, more than a quarter of the workforce is now considered “functionally unemployed,” marking the highest level since June 2021. In January 2026, the percentage of the American workforce considered "functionally unemployed" dropped from a four-year high in December but still remains higher than a year ago.

The Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity (LISEP) was created in 2019 by Ludwig and his wife, Dr. Carol Ludwig. The mission of LISEP is to improve the economic well-being of middle- and lower-income Americans through research and education. LISEP's original economic research includes new indicators for unemployment, earnings, and cost of living. These metrics aim to provide policymakers and the public with a more transparent view of the economic situation of all Americans, [...] WASHINGTON, June 18, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- The percentage of American workers unable to secure full-time, above-poverty-wage jobs continues to tick upward, with nearly one-fourth now classified as "functionally unemployed," according to the latest report from the Ludwig Institute for Shared Economic Prosperity (LISEP).
